verdict.rationale: Milvus has a first-party full-text search feature. It accepts raw text and converts it into sparse embeddings inside the database, so keyword-style search runs natively without a separate search engine. Milvus Lite docs also list sparse vector search and hybrid_search as built-in features. missing for 10: explicit documentation of keyword-relevance details (e.g., BM25 scoring, analyzers/tokenizers), independent or hands-on corroboration of full-text search quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run keyword/full-text search over documents inside the database without bolting on a separate search engine

citations.quote: it simplifies vector searches by accepting raw text input, automatically converting your text data into sparse embeddings without the need to manually generate vector embeddings.
covers most of the features such as vector data persistence and management, vector CRUD operations, sparse and dense vector search, metadata filtering, multi-vector and hybrid_search.
if you want hybrid search, different IVF variants, disk-based search, horizontal scaling, SIMD, or sparse vectors, Milvus is great.
